shots.title: Design SQLite and PostgreSQL canonical sprint key migrations

hazards.description: [architect review] PostgreSQL v6 migration omitted workflow definition columns required by startExecution; fixture modeled columns that real v5 schemas lacked

shots.notes: Added atomic SQLite v9 and PostgreSQL v6 migrations from numeric sprint columns to canonical text keys.

shots.title: Migrate store records and adapters to canonical sprint keys

hazards.description: [architect review] PostgreSQL rowToExecution omitted definition_json and definition_hash, preventing persisted workflow definitions from round-tripping

shots.notes: Canonicalized claims, scorecards, events, and workflow execution sprint identity at both adapter boundaries.

shots.title: Prove distinct canonical sprint round-trips

hazards.description: A build and test run were initially overlapped, causing transient dist rewrite failures before the gates were rerun sequentially.

shots.notes: Proved 458.1 and 458.10 remain distinct across SQLite and PostgreSQL, including rollback and structural migration guarantees.

conditions.description: The sprint changed persistent identity across SQLite, PostgreSQL, core store contracts, and compatibility consumers.

training.description: Migration fixtures must begin from the exact prior production schema, and adapter reads must be audited alongside writes.
training.outcome: The PostgreSQL fixture now mirrors v5, structural rollback is proven, and workflow definitions round-trip through both adapters.

nutrition.description: Local regression: 259 test files and 4,330 tests passed; PostgreSQL CI: 260 test files and 4,362 tests passed.
Production build, TypeScript typecheck, CodeQL, and GitGuardian passed on the exact reviewed head.

bunker_locations: Model the exact previous production schema in every migration fixture; target-schema columns can hide upgrade failures.
Audit store row mappers whenever schema writes add or restore fields.
Assert constraints, indexes, and foreign-key actions after table-rebuild migrations.
yardage_book_updates: Use canonical text keys at SQL bind and row boundaries before comparing or sorting sprint identities.
Prove migration failure rolls back both schema changes and schema_version writes.
Exercise PostgreSQL migrations in hosted CI when a local PostgreSQL service is unavailable.
course_management_notes: S266 must remove Number-based compatibility bridges so API and display consumers cannot collapse 458.10 into 458.1.
